# WorldFreightHub

WorldFreightHub is a freight intelligence reference for two China export corridors — China to the GCC and China to Europe: shipping routes, destination countries, ports and terminals, freight methods, glossary definitions, cost and transit-time guides, a verification-first provider directory (103 real freight forwarders, all source-backed), and interactive freight calculators.

All freight rates and transit times are indicative estimates, not live quotes. Verify figures with the relevant carrier, port authority, or customs authority before making commercial decisions.

## Main

- [Home](https://worldfreighthub.net/): China to GCC freight intelligence overview.
- [Routes](https://worldfreighthub.net/routes/): China to GCC shipping routes with indicative transit times.
- [Countries](https://worldfreighthub.net/countries/): GCC destination country profiles with VAT, capitals, currencies, and ports.
- [Ports](https://worldfreighthub.net/ports/): GCC destination ports and China origin port profiles.
- [Methods](https://worldfreighthub.net/methods/): FCL, LCL, air, rail, DDP, and express shipping methods.
- [Glossary](https://worldfreighthub.net/glossary/): Freight and customs terminology definitions.
- [Middle East](https://worldfreighthub.net/middleeast/): China-to-GCC corridor overview.

## Middle East corridors

- [Saudi Arabia](https://worldfreighthub.net/middleeast/shipping-from-china-to-saudi-arabia/): route pillar — ports (Jeddah, Dammam, Riyadh Dry Port), SABER/SASO, 15% VAT, 5% duty.
- [United Arab Emirates](https://worldfreighthub.net/middleeast/shipping-from-china-to-uae/): route pillar — Jebel Ali, Khalifa, Sharjah ports, 5% VAT.
- [Qatar](https://worldfreighthub.net/middleeast/shipping-from-china-to-qatar/): route pillar — Hamad Port, customs and duty.
- [Kuwait](https://worldfreighthub.net/middleeast/shipping-from-china-to-kuwait/): route pillar — Kuwait ports, customs and duty.
- [Oman](https://worldfreighthub.net/middleeast/shipping-from-china-to-oman/): route pillar — Oman ports, customs and duty.
- [Bahrain](https://worldfreighthub.net/middleeast/shipping-from-china-to-bahrain/): route pillar — Khalifa bin Salman port, 10% VAT, King Fahd Causeway.
- [SABER / SASO certification](https://worldfreighthub.net/middleeast/saso-saber-certification/): Saudi product conformity requirements.
- [Jeddah vs Dammam](https://worldfreighthub.net/middleeast/jeddah-vs-dammam/): Saudi port comparison.

## Europe corridor

China to Europe freight intelligence: 15 destination markets with national import VAT, EU common duty, EORI/UK EORI registration, port and rail gateways, and a verified European forwarder directory.

- [Europe hub](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/): corridor overview for the China-to-Europe market.
- [Europe data](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/data/): 12-market import VAT, EU common duty and (1+duty)×(1+VAT) landed-cost table.
- [Europe rail](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/rail/): China–Europe rail benchmarks (Xi'an/Chengdu–Duisburg/Hamburg) against sea and air.
- [Europe routes](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/routes/): China origin ports to European gateways with indicative transit times.
- [Europe ports](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/ports/): destination ports and terminals (Hamburg, Rotterdam, Antwerp, Le Havre, Valencia, Genoa, Gdańsk, Felixstowe and more).
- [Europe directory](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/directory/): verified European rail and freight operators with sources.
- [Europe country guides](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/countries/): destination country profiles — duty, VAT, EORI and gateway ports.
- [Germany](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-germany/): route pillar — national import VAT 19%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [United Kingdom](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-united-kingdom/): route pillar — national import VAT 20%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [France](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-france/): route pillar — national import VAT 20%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Netherlands](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-netherlands/): route pillar — national import VAT 21%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Spain](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-spain/): route pillar — national import VAT 21%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Italy](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-italy/): route pillar — national import VAT 22%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Poland](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-poland/): route pillar — national import VAT 23%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Belgium](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-belgium/): route pillar — national import VAT 21%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Austria](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-austria/): route pillar — national import VAT 20%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Sweden](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-sweden/): route pillar — national import VAT 25%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Portugal](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-portugal/): route pillar — national import VAT 23%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Greece](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-greece/): route pillar — national import VAT 24%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Ireland](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-ireland/): route pillar — national import VAT 23%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Denmark](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-denmark/): route pillar — national import VAT 25%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.
- [Finland](https://worldfreighthub.net/europe/shipping-from-china-to-finland/): route pillar — national import VAT 25.5%, EU common duty (UK: post-Brexit UKGT), EORI and gateway ports.

Landing-cost arithmetic: (CIF + duty) × (1 + VAT). Statutory examples — Germany 19%, France 20%, Italy 22%, Spain 21%, Poland 23%, Sweden 25%, Denmark 25%, Finland 25.5%, UK 20%.

## Tools

- [CBM Calculator](https://worldfreighthub.net/tools/cbm-calculator/): cargo volume (CBM) calculation.
- [Container Loading Calculator](https://worldfreighthub.net/tools/container-loading-calculator/): carton-per-container estimation.
- [Volumetric Weight Calculator](https://worldfreighthub.net/tools/volumetric-weight-calculator/): chargeable weight for air/express.

## Provider directory

- [Freight Provider Directory](https://worldfreighthub.net/directory/): verification-first directory of 103 freight forwarders and customs brokers on the China-to-GCC corridor. All listings are source-backed and marked unverified until independently confirmed.

## Trust

- [Methodology](https://worldfreighthub.net/methodology/): How route, port, and rate information is sourced and labeled.
- [Editorial Policy](https://worldfreighthub.net/editorial-policy/): Confidence levels, corrections, and source standards.
- [About](https://worldfreighthub.net/about/): About the project and its coverage.
- [Contact](https://worldfreighthub.net/contact/): Corrections and partnership enquiries.

## Request a quote

- [Get Quote](https://worldfreighthub.net/get-quote/): Submit a freight quote request for a China-to-GCC shipment. Requests are routed to a provider on the corridor; no obligation, no fee.
